title: Cloud Computing
description: Comprehensive course covering cloud computing fundamentals, service models, architecture, security, and major cloud platforms

topics.title: Introduction to Cloud Computing
topics.description: Comprehensive foundation of cloud computing concepts, history, characteristics, and benefits

topics.title: Cloud Service Models
topics.description: In-depth study of IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, and emerging service models with real-world examples

topics.title: Cloud Deployment Models
topics.description: Detailed coverage of public, private, hybrid, and multi-cloud deployment strategies

topics.title: Virtualization Technologies
topics.description: Comprehensive study of hypervisors, containers, virtual machines, and virtualization platforms

topics.title: Cloud Storage Solutions
topics.description: Extensive coverage of object storage, block storage, file storage, databases, and data management

topics.title: Cloud Security and Compliance
topics.description: In-depth coverage of security models, encryption, identity management, compliance, and best practices

topics.title: Major Cloud Providers
topics.description: Comprehensive overview of AWS, Azure, GCP, and their core services and architectures

topics.title: Advanced Cloud Topics
topics.description: Serverless computing, cloud-native applications, microservices, DevOps, and emerging trends

prerequisites: Basic programming knowledge helpful but not required
learningOutcomes: Understand cloud computing concepts and architecture
Differentiate between cloud service and deployment models
Design secure and scalable cloud infrastructure
Work with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Apply cloud security and compliance best practices
